items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And it was Bill Johnson's band... And so they had Emmanuel and Freddie, Freddie Kevick, Jimmy Newman, and they had Eddie Vincent.

ctx.x: He had the band. Yeah, I couldn't call his name just then. Yeah. And then right across the street was Joe Oliver played over there. Holly Powers did the singing. Joe was doubling, he was doubling at the Pekin. He'd leave the Dreamland and go to Pekin. And then later, at that time now, this Royal Garden, this is when I first saw, I saw Emmanuel Perez here, but this Paul Barber, he was playing drums with this band. And it was Bill Johnson's band, bass player, who lived to be a hundred years old, died, I think it…
What about have the Lottie Taylor? Oh, Lottie Taylor?
